title: SAIA 2.3.6 has a documented MCP 2.1.0 incompatibility
problem: SAIA-10157 explicitly documents that SAIA 2.3.6 is incompatible with MCP 2.1.0. The separate ITSI subagent About page supplies minimum versions and tool prerequisites. Meeting all the published minima does not establish this exact pairing, a replacement combination or any regional rollout.

audiences: Readers planning the ITSI subagent dependency chain
exclusions: No other app pairing, regional rollout or tenant activation is established.

scopeComparison: The subagent About page documents dependency floors. SAIA-10157 documents an exact pair exception.

impact.customerScenario: A reader plans a SAIA 2.3.6 and MCP 2.1.0 combination while checking the ITSI subagent floors.
impact.consequence: Confirm the exact supported app pair before planning enablement.

confidence.rationale: The exact version pair is directly named in the current vendor issue row. Scope remains limited to that pair.
